mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance (emp_id, work_date, status, note) VALUES (#{empId}, #{workDate}, #{status}, #{note}) ON CONFLICT (emp_id, work_date) DO UPDATE SET status = EXCLUDED.status, note = EXCLUDED.note
INSERT INTO attendance (emp_id, work_date, check_in, work_minutes, overtime_minutes, status) VALUES (#{empId}, #{workDate}, #{checkIn}, 0, 0, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS team_size, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('LEAVE', 'HALF_LEAVE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS absent_count FROM employee e LEFT JOIN attendance a ON a.emp_id = e.emp_id AND a.work_date = #{date} WHERE e.dept_id = #{deptId} AND e.use_yn = 'Y'
